chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 636: The Ninety-Nine Stone Steps Shattered
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen ascends the Ninety-Nine Stone Steps, surrounded by Stone Man Kings. With the Three Sovereign Mirror and the puppet, he fights to survive as the ancient stone gate opens, heralding a new catastrophe.
og_title: World of Immortality – Chapter 636: The Collapse of the Stone Steps
og_description: Xiao Chen battles over ten Stone Man Kings atop the sacred steps, using the Three Sovereign Mirror to break the trial path. A menacing shadow emerges from the sealed gate.
twitter_title: WofI Ch. 636 – The Ninety-Nine Stone Steps
twitter_description: A desperate confrontation on the sacred steps as Xiao Chen shatters the trial path and a forgotten evil stirs behind the stone gate.
